messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@lumenhealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Embedded demo CTA for AWS Marketplace listing — initial ask

Hi Sofia / Kimberly,

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick summary and asks so we don't lose momentum: LumenHealth wants an "Try demo" CTA on our AWS Marketplace offer page that launches a lightweight hosted sandbox (no billing) and records metrics for co-sell tracking. Attached is our current product page draft and a rough demo flow diagram.

Asks: 
- Can Redwood confirm any constraints for embedding a sandbox link from the listing (security/AMI/redirect rules)?
- We need 2 variants of hero CTA copy for A/B: (a) "Try demo — no credit card" and (b) "Launch interactive demo". Please advise recommended microcopy.
- Any analytics/tracking query params we should include to attribute Marketplace referrals for co-sell reporting?

Target launch: Nov 1 public listing update. We're working on procurement / legal but want copy and technical handoff by next week.

Attaching: lumen_product_page_draft_v1.md, embedded_demo_flow.png, lumen_marketplace_requirements.xlsx

Best,
Alicia
Director of Partnerships
LumenHealth

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 10:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Embedded demo CTA for AWS Marketplace listing — initial ask

Hi Alicia — great to connect. Looping in Aditya from Marketplace partnerships for the AMI/redirect constraints. Below are initial notes and recommended microcopy.

Quick answers/high-level:
- AWS marketplace pages can't host arbitrary iframes that point to third-party origins; the accepted pattern is a CTA that redirects users to a secure, customer-hosted sandbox URL (we can surface this as a deep link). For PrivateOffer/Private Marketplace you can use more integrated flows, but for public listing redirect is safest.
- Analytics: append utm_source=aws_marketplace&utm_medium=listing&utm_campaign=try_demo and include a hashed partner_id (we can provide a param to map back to your co-sell record). Timestamp+session-id for telemetry is recommended.

Recommended CTA copy (short list):
- Variant A (Trust-focused): "Try demo — no credit card"
- Variant B (Action-focused): "Launch interactive demo"
- Supporting microcopy under hero (1-liner): "Sandboxed walkthrough of LumenHealth on Redwood Inference — explore sample workflows in 5 minutes."

Operational handoff checklist (we can create a template):
- Finalize sandbox URL + CORS/security review
- Provide tracking params and expected event names (visit, launch_demo, complete_flow)
- Provide 120x60 and 600x300 hero assets for listing
- Confirm whether you want the demo to auto-create a temporary API key (we recommend ephemeral tokens scoped to demo only)

Next steps: Kimberly will prepare a marketplace copy pass with quick edits and a short hero + CTA matrix for A/B. Aditya will confirm any partner param format needed for co-sell attribution. Can you confirm availability for a 30-min handoff on Thu 9/23?

Cheers,
Sofia
Product Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
